caption:
Hard to forgive a relative? Read this

Allah tells those who have been given more not to swear to hold back their help from relatives and those in need. Let them pardon and overlook. Then He asks, "Do you not like to be forgiven by Allah?"

Surah An-Noor 24:22

Name one person you will pardon this week, even if only in your heart.

#forgiveness #familyties #surahnur #letitgo

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: The people of virtue and affluence among you should not swear to withhold their aid from their relatives, the needy and the emigrants in the cause of Allah. Let them pardon and overlook. Do you not like to be forgiven by Allah? For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful (Surah An-Noor 24:22)
